in_marathi.name: Vishan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Abode
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vishan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vishwa' meaning universe and 'Asan' meaning seated, making the name Vishan translate to 'The God who is seated on the universe'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is the preserver of the universe, and is often depicted as seated on the coils of the divine serpent Ananta.

In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is the preserver of the universe, and is often depicted as seated on the coils of the divine serpent Ananta.
